# Evercraft | Try three free tools
Public landing page: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/try/
Customer promise: three free existing browser experiences, no account, credit card or sales call.

1. AI Boardroom free answer comparator: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/ai-boardroom/compare/
   Paste two or three AI responses and examine explicit recommendation differences, overlapping themes and evidence questions. Local browser processing. This does NOT connect to other remote AI models or fact-check claims.
2. Evercraft Research free scope builder: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/research/
   Frame a question and save a private scope. NOT a completed professional research report.
3. Work Saban free synthetic report demo: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/work-saban/demo/
   Run a small, reproducible, synthetic sample arithmetic report. NOT a live multi-agent execution demonstration.

Do not describe any free demo as paid work, a real client case study, or verified customer usage. No unverified visitor or conversion counts. Individual service prices and processor checkout URLs are separate. The service pages sell the named work; Evercraft Payments is only transaction/order infrastructure. No claims of new $9 checkout or live 99-cent ROASTED purchase.

Paid service directory: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/
Founder-friendly introduction: share the individual free tool relevant to a real person's problem; do not flood unrelated groups or use an unrelated brand's social account.

These links are owned product URLs, not independent real-world reach receipts. Measure external impressions, verified human visits, engaged tool sessions, qualified inquiries, paid receipts and repeats separately once privacy-respecting measurement is actually deployed.
